'''Star Tours Flight 420''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Elshandruu Pica]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1C at 1045 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1140.
